part1_desc: 第 1–24 步：跟站长学写对比邮件。
part2_desc: 第 25–36 步：自己给新供应商写邮件。
note: 本课阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：邮件结构、比较级/最高级书面表达。Unit 3 Computers 主题。

steps.title: 供应商的邮件
steps.teach_html:
站长收到供应商的邮件：有三款显示器（monitor，显示器），问广播站想订哪款。

站长让你回一封邮件，对比三款显示器，推荐一款。写邮件和打电话不一样：要把比较级、最高级写清楚，对方看不见你的表情，只能看文字。

今天学写邮件里的比较和推荐。

steps.title: 显示器词汇
steps.reading:
Monitor A: 21 inches, 800 yuan, clear picture
Monitor B: 24 inches, 1200 yuan, clearest picture
Monitor C: 19 inches, 500 yuan, not clear
steps.teach_html:
先看三款显示器的资料，生词：

  • monitor（显示器）：电脑的屏幕
  • inch（英寸）：屏幕大小单位，数字越大屏幕越大
  • clear（清晰的）：画面清楚

A：21英寸，800元，清晰；B：24英寸，1200元，最清晰；C：19英寸，500元，不清晰。

steps.title: 邮件开头
steps.teach_html:
写邮件先写开头：

  • Dear Mr. Wang,（亲爱的王先生，）
  • Thank you for your email.（谢谢您的邮件。）

然后说正事：I want to compare the three monitors.（我想对比三款显示器。）

steps.title: 邮件里写比较
steps.teach_html:
邮件里对比，用比较级 + than：

  • Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A.（B比A大。）
  • Monitor B is more expensive than Monitor C.（B比C贵。）

写清楚谁比谁，than 后面跟被比的那个。

steps.title: 邮件里写推荐
steps.teach_html:
推荐用最高级 + I recommend（我推荐）：

  • Monitor B has the clearest picture.（B的画面最清晰。）
  • I recommend Monitor B.（我推荐B。）

recommend（推荐）是邮件里的关键词，看到它就知道是推荐。

steps.title: 邮件结尾
steps.teach_html:
邮件结尾：

  • Please reply soon.（请尽快回复。）
  • Best wishes,（祝好，）
  • 你的名字

reply（回复）这个词 Unit 2 学过，这里再用一次。

steps.title: 看范文
steps.reading:
Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your email. I want to compare the three monitors.
Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A. It is also more expensive than Monitor C.
Monitor B has the clearest picture. I recommend Monitor B.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.teach_html:
上面是一封范文。从头到尾看一遍，找：

  • 比较级：bigger than、more expensive than
  • 最高级：the clearest
  • 推荐：I recommend

写邮件时照着这个结构：开头 → 对比 → 推荐 → 结尾。

steps.title: 准备写邮件
steps.teach_html:
记住邮件四部分：

  1. 开头：Dear…，Thank you for your email.
  2. 对比：A is bigger than B.（比较级+than）
  3. 推荐：the clearest… I recommend…（最高级+推荐）
  4. 结尾：Please reply soon. Best wishes.

下面站长带着你写。

steps.title: 范文在手
steps.reading:
Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your email. I want to compare the three monitors.
Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A. It is also more expensive than Monitor C.
Monitor B has the clearest picture. I recommend Monitor B.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He

steps.title: bigger 的原级
steps.reading:
Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your email. I want to compare the three monitors.
Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A. It is also more expensive than Monitor C.
Monitor B has the clearest picture. I recommend Monitor B.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: "bigger than" 里，bigger 的原级是？

wrong_feedback.B: 拼写错了，原级是 big，不是 biger。
wrong_feedback.C: more big 不对，big 是短单词。
wrong_feedback.D: biggest 是最高级，要的是原级。

steps.title: the clearest
steps.reading:
Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your email. I want to compare the three monitors.
Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A. It is also more expensive than Monitor C.
Monitor B has the clearest picture. I recommend Monitor B.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: 范文里 "the clearest picture" 是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.A: 更清晰是 clearer，the clearest 是最高级。再想想。
wrong_feedback.B: clear 才是清晰的，the clearest 是最高级。
wrong_feedback.C: 不清晰是 not clear。再想想。

steps.title: recommend 的意思
steps.reading:
Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your email. I want to compare the three monitors.
Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A. It is also more expensive than Monitor C.
Monitor B has the clearest picture. I recommend Monitor B.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: "I recommend Monitor B" 里，recommend 是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.A: 退货是 return。再想想第 5 步。
wrong_feedback.D: 比较是 compare。recommend 是推荐。

steps.title: 邮件结构
steps.stem: 范文里，对比部分在第几段？
steps.help: 数段落：开头、对比、推荐、结尾。

wrong_feedback.A: 第一段是开头（Dear…）。再数一遍。
wrong_feedback.B: 第三段是推荐。再数一遍。
wrong_feedback.D: 第四段是结尾。再数一遍。

steps.title: than 后面
steps.reading:
Dear Mr. Wang,
Thank you for your email. I want to compare the three monitors.
Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A. It is also more expensive than Monitor C.
Monitor B has the clearest picture. I recommend Monitor B.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: "Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A" 里，than 后面是？
steps.help: A is … than B，than 后面是谁？
steps.explain: than 后面跟被比的 B（这里是 A）。

wrong_feedback.B: B 是主语（比较的那个），than 后面是被比的。再想想。
wrong_feedback.C: 有规律：than 后面跟被比的。再想想。
wrong_feedback.D: 有规律的。再想想第 4 步。

steps.title: inch 的意思
steps.stem: inch 是什么意思？
steps.help: 第 2 步学过，屏幕大小单位。

wrong_feedback.A: 英里是 mile。再想想第 2 步。

steps.title: 补全对比句
steps.stem: Monitor A is ______ than Monitor C.（更大）

steps.title: 补全推荐句
steps.stem: I ______ Monitor B.（推荐）

steps.title: 写最高级
steps.stem: Monitor B has ______ picture.（最清晰的）
steps.help: clear 的最高级，前面加 the。

steps.title: 写开头
steps.stem: 写出邮件开头的称呼：亲爱的王先生，

common_errors.when: Mr 写成 mr 没大写
common_errors.say: Mr 的 M 要大写。

steps.title: 写结尾
steps.stem: 写出：请尽快回复。

common_errors.say: r-e-p-l-y，注意是 reply 不是 replay。

steps.title: 小结一下
steps.teach_html:
邮件小结：

  • 开头：Dear Mr. Wang, / Thank you for your email.
  • 对比：bigger than / more expensive than
  • 推荐：the clearest / I recommend
  • 结尾：Please reply soon. / Best wishes,

下面新的供应商，你自己写邮件。

steps.title: 连词成句
steps.stem: A / cheaper / is / than / C

steps.title: 选推荐句
steps.stem: 下面哪句适合写在推荐部分？
options: Monitor B is bigger than A.
steps.help: 推荐部分的关键词是什么？

wrong_feedback.A: 这是对比句，放对比部分。再想想。

steps.title: 写完整对比
steps.stem: 写一句话：B 比 A 大，也比 C 贵。
steps.answer_text: Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A and more expensive than Monitor C.

answers: monitor b is bigger than monitor a and more expensive than monitor c
b is bigger than a and more expensive than c

steps.help: bigger than … and more expensive than …
steps.explain: Monitor B is bigger than Monitor A and more expensive than Monitor C.

common_errors.say: 两个对比都要写：bigger than 和 more expensive than。

steps.title: 新的邮件任务
steps.reading:
Dear Ms. Li,
Thank you for your email. Here are two keyboards:
Keyboard X: 200 yuan, quiet, comfortable
Keyboard Y: 350 yuan, quieter, most comfortable
Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable.
I recommend Keyboard Y.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.teach_html:
新供应商李女士发来两款键盘（keyboard，键盘）。资料和范文都在上面。

这次你自己写回信，站长不帮忙。记住四部分：开头、对比、推荐、结尾。

生词：quiet（安静的）、comfortable（舒服的）。

steps.title: quieter 的原级
steps.reading:
Dear Ms. Li,
Thank you for your email. Here are two keyboards:
Keyboard X: 200 yuan, quiet, comfortable
Keyboard Y: 350 yuan, quieter, most comfortable
Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable.
I recommend Keyboard Y.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: "quieter" 的原级是？

wrong_feedback.A: quite 是“相当”，不是原级。再想想。
wrong_feedback.B: more quiet 不对，quiet 是短单词。

steps.title: most comfortable
steps.reading:
Dear Ms. Li,
Thank you for your email. Here are two keyboards:
Keyboard X: 200 yuan, quiet, comfortable
Keyboard Y: 350 yuan, quieter, most comfortable
Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable.
I recommend Keyboard Y.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: "the most comfortable" 是什么意思？

wrong_feedback.B: 更舒服是 more comfortable。再想想。
wrong_feedback.C: comfortable 才是舒服的，the most comfortable 是最高级。
wrong_feedback.D: uncomfortable 才是不舒服的。再想想。

steps.title: 推荐哪款
steps.reading:
Dear Ms. Li,
Thank you for your email. Here are two keyboards:
Keyboard X: 200 yuan, quiet, comfortable
Keyboard Y: 350 yuan, quieter, most comfortable
Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable.
I recommend Keyboard Y.
Please reply soon.
Best wishes,
Xiao He
steps.stem: 范文推荐的是哪款？

wrong_feedback.A: 范文说 I recommend Keyboard Y。再找一遍。
wrong_feedback.B: Z 没出现过。再找一遍。

steps.title: keyboard 的意思
steps.stem: keyboard 是什么意思？

steps.title: 写对比句
steps.scene: 写 Y 和 X 的对比。
steps.stem: Keyboard Y is ______ than Keyboard X.（更安静）

steps.title: 写推荐
steps.stem: I ______ Keyboard Y.（推荐）

steps.title: 写开头
steps.stem: 写出：亲爱的李女士，
steps.help: Dear + Ms. Li + 逗号。女士用 Ms.。

common_errors.say: 李女士用 Ms.，不是 Mr.。

steps.title: 写完整邮件
steps.stem: 写两句话：Y 比 X 安静。Y 是最舒服的。
steps.answer_text: Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable.

answers: keyboard y is quieter than keyboard x. it is the most comfortable
y is quieter than x. it is the most comfortable

steps.explain: Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable.

steps.title: 写结尾
steps.stem: 写出：祝好，

steps.title: 写全文
steps.stem: 用四部分写一封完整邮件：给李女士回信，推荐 Y 键盘。
steps.task: 写英文，包含开头、对比、推荐、结尾。
steps.answer_text: Dear Ms. Li, Thank you for your email. Keyboard Y is quieter than Keyboard X. It is the most comfortable. I recommend Keyboard Y. Please reply soon. Best wishes,
steps.help: 开头 Dear…，对比 quieter than…，推荐 I recommend…，结尾 Best wishes。
steps.explain: 参考范文结构，四部分都要有。

common_errors.say: 四部分：开头、对比、推荐、结尾，检查缺了哪个。

steps.title: 节目预告
steps.teach_html:
邮件发出去了，供应商很快回复说就订 Y 键盘。站长说：你写的邮件清楚、专业。

下期是科技大直播，Unit 3 的内容来个总复习。比较级、最高级、电话、邮件，全部上阵。好好准备！
